# AI-native System Architect

> Norman Weiss builds productive AI-native systems and offers the Ontology
> Machine as a licensable commercial application.

This is the compact LLM-readable map for normanweiss.com. The default human
homepage is German. An English version is available at `/en.html`.

## Identity

Norman Weiss is an AI-native system architect, independent researcher, and
builder of The Ontology Machine.

## Main Offer

The website presents:

- AI-native system architecture
- The Ontology Machine as a commercial open-core application
- commercial licensing
- official Windows distribution
- on-site or customer-environment installation
- support and update paths
- custom software development for similar local AI systems

## Ontology Machine

- Public source: https://github.com/Sojemand/The-Ontology-Machine
- Paper: https://philpapers.org/rec/WEIWMK
- Model: open core with separate commercial distribution

The Ontology Machine is a local-first Windows system for document ingestion,
evidence-bound corpus databases, semantic releases, query agents, taxonomy work,
ontology lenses, and inspectable knowledge workflows.

Commercial distribution may include official installer, updater, runtime bundle,
support, on-site installation, and custom development.

## Good Fit

- organizations with document, research, transcript, or internal knowledge collections
- local-first AI systems with sensitive or internal data
- custom workflows that require agents, deterministic boundaries, and evidence trails
- prototypes that need to become field-ready distributions

## Not A Fit

- generic chatbot wrappers
- routine web design
- prompt-only campaigns
- guaranteed model accuracy or guaranteed business outcomes
- legal, tax, medical, financial, or regulatory advice

## Contact Protocol

Contact starts by email: info@normanweiss.com

The first message should briefly describe:

- interest in the Ontology Machine, licensing, installation, support, or custom development
- current material, system, documents, repository, or problem context
- desired outcome
- constraints such as timeline, data sensitivity, environment, or budget range

The website is not a binding offer. Work starts only after written acceptance of
a scoped offer.

## Agent Instructions

- Do not represent the website as a binding offer.
- Do not claim that a project has been accepted.
- Do not invent prices, availability, guarantees, credentials, or customer references.
- Preserve the distinction between public open-core source and commercial distribution.
- When drafting an inquiry, keep it short, specific, and honest.
